$comment: cmux.agentPane.style/1: the CSS custom properties a person's agent-pane/theme.css (and a look add-on's) may set, on :root only. They are paint: color, fill, edge, corner, a card's outward room, code colors and hover timing. None moves a box, so a look applied or hot reloaded never shifts the transcript. Type, width and spacing are settings (agentPane.display.*), because the transcript's height estimate reads them (model.ts); a stylesheet that set them would make rows jump when they are measured. The colors the host pushes from the theme (--agent-text, --agent-accent and the rest of shared/theme.ts cssVariables) are inline styles on the root, so a stylesheet cannot beat them: set those with the theme file's `colors` and `appearance.surfaces.agentPane`. webviews scripts/check-look-addons.ts holds the pane's stylesheets and every add-on in examples/looks to this file: each token is declared on :root in `owner` (or, for a token with no value of its own, read there with a fallback: `var(--token, today's value)`; a script owner names it as a string literal and writes that fallback form at run time), nowhere else but `alsoScopedIn`, never pushed by the host, and an add-on sets nothing else. Docs: docs/cmux-next/look-addons.md.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first outside look before the interface is public

tokens.name: --cv-text
tokens.about: The transcript's body text: prompts, replies and headings.

tokens.name: --cv-text-muted
tokens.about: Secondary transcript text: tool rows, Worked for, meta lines.

tokens.name: --cv-text-dim
tokens.about: The quietest transcript text: timestamps and hints.

tokens.name: --cv-link
tokens.about: Links in replies.

tokens.name: --agent-link
tokens.about: Links in the rest of the pane (chips, cards, the composer).

tokens.name: --cv-card-fill
tokens.about: The fill of every card in the transcript: opened tool output, code, edited files. Unset: each card keeps its own strength (the theme's text at 4%, code at 7.5%).

tokens.name: --cv-card-ring
tokens.about: The hairline around those cards (none under appearance.borders: none). Unset: each card keeps its own.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-tint
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's glass tint. Unset: the theme's text at 14%.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-edge
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's hairline edge. Unset: none (transparent).

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-radius
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's corner radius. Unset: 12 px at the chat's text scale. A corner never changes the bubble's box.

tokens.name: --cv-reply-fill
tokens.about: The agent's reply as a card: its fill, on the reply's row. Unset: transparent, no card.

tokens.name: --cv-reply-ring
tokens.about: The reply card's hairline, on the outer edge of its room. Unset: none (transparent).

tokens.name: --cv-reply-radius
tokens.about: The reply card's corner radius. Unset: 0 (square). A corner never changes the row's box.

tokens.name: --cv-reply-padding
tokens.about: The reply card's room around the text on every side, painted outward past the row (the fill spread as a shadow), so the text and every row stay where they are. Unset: 0. Keep it within the gap between rows (12 px or less), or the card reaches under its neighbours.

tokens.name: --cv-hover-duration
tokens.about: How long an icon button's fill and ink, and a tool row's words, take to change under the pointer. Unset: 0s (on the frame the pointer arrives). Reduce Motion, cmux motion off or reduced, and ui.animationSpeed off keep it instant.

tokens.name: --cv-hover-ease
tokens.about: The easing of that hover change. Unset: ease (unseen while the duration is 0s).

tokens.name: --cv-popover-fill
tokens.about: The fill of the pane's menus, pickers and popovers, over their frost, on the page's glass and the App's. Unset: the menu level's own tint. Lens, Spectrum and Reduce Transparency keep theirs.

tokens.name: --cv-popover-ring
tokens.about: Those popups' hairline edge. Unset: the theme's text at 12%. appearance.borders none and Increase Contrast win over it.

tokens.name: --cv-popover-radius
tokens.about: Those popups' corner radius, which the pane's other floating cards share; a row's highlight stays concentric with it. Unset: the design scale's popup radius (8 px).

tokens.name: --cv-popover-row-selected
tokens.about: The fill of a menu's or picker's highlighted row (pointer or keys), and of the hover fills inside a popup. Unset: each keeps its own (the accent at 20% on a menu row, the text at 14% in the pickers).

tokens.name: --cv-code-comment
tokens.about: Comments in highlighted code (code blocks, edits, commands). Unset: the terminal palette's slot 8.

tokens.name: --cv-code-string
tokens.about: Strings in highlighted code. Unset: palette slot 2.

tokens.name: --cv-code-constant
tokens.about: Numbers and language constants in highlighted code. Unset: palette slot 3.

tokens.name: --cv-code-keyword
tokens.about: Keywords in highlighted code. Unset: palette slot 5.

tokens.name: --cv-code-function
tokens.about: Function names in highlighted code. Unset: palette slot 4.

tokens.name: --cv-code-type
tokens.about: Type and class names in highlighted code. Unset: palette slot 6.
